mapper.select: {CALL sp_save_webauthn_credential( #{operation, mode=IN, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{id, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{credentialId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publicKeyCose, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{counter, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{transports, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{label, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createdAt, mode=IN, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{lastUsedAt, mode=IN, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{resultId, mode=OUT, jdbcType=BIGINT} )}

SELECT c.id, c.credential_id, c.public_key_cose, c.counter, c.transports, c.label, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.last_used_at, u.id as user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.display_name, u.user_handle, u.enabled, u.account_non_expired, u.account_non_locked, u.credentials_non_expired FROM webauthn_credentials c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.credential_id, c.public_key_cose, c.counter, c.transports, c.label, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.last_used_at, u.id as user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.display_name, u.user_handle, u.enabled, u.account_non_expired, u.account_non_locked, u.credentials_non_expired FROM webauthn_credentials c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.credential_id = #{credentialId}

SELECT c.id, c.credential_id, c.public_key_cose, c.counter, c.transports, c.label, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.last_used_at, u.id as user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.display_name, u.user_handle, u.enabled, u.account_non_expired, u.account_non_locked, u.credentials_non_expired FROM webauthn_credentials c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
